acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to paint a room in the East Bay area varies based on factors like room size, ceiling height, condition of walls, and paint quality. For a basic 10x12 foot room, you might expect to pay a certain range, but we provide free, no-obligation estimates after an on-site assessment to give you an accurate price tailored to your specific needs.
